'''Ngihya Nyugen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 San Francisco tournament]] on 10 September 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|pre-Death Star II Hunt Down]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-san-francisco-ca-9-10-00d1231/ san-francisco-ca-9-10-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 16 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-san-francisco-ca-9-10-00d1231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
